description_en: Modifies the name or description of a VPC peering connection
description_zh: 调用ModifyVpcPeerConnection接口修改VPC对等连接实例的名称或者描述信息
name: ModifyVpcPeerConnection

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC peering connection whose name or description you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改名称或者描述信息的VPC对等连接实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the VPC peering connection.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的VPC对等连接的名称，即修改后的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the VPC peering connection.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的VPC对等连接的描述信息，即修改后的描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The new bandwidth of the VPC peering connection. Unit: Mbit/s. The value must be an integer greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的VPC对等连接的带宽，单位：Mbps，取值范围为大于0的整数
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without modifying the information. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The link type.

Valid values: Platinum and Gold. Default value: Gold.

To specify this parameter, make sure that you create a cross-region peering connection
parameters.help_zh:
链路类型。

可选值为 Platinum（铂金），Gold（金），默认为 Gold（金）。

如需指定该参数，请确保您创建的是跨地域的对等连接
parameters.name: link_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the jumbo frame feature is enabled for the VPC peering connection. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled.
Note: To specify this parameter, make sure that you create a cross-region peering connection
parameters.help_zh:
VPC 对等连接是否开启了 Jumbo frame 特性。取值：
true：开启。
false：未开启。
说明 如需指定该参数，请确保您创建的是跨地域的对等连接
parameters.name: enable_jumbo_frame
